Lemma
[widening a single-chart time window]

Let $\gamma :\mathbb R\to M$ be continuous and suppose $\gamma (t)$ lies in the source of a single chart for every $t\in [0,1]$. Then it still does on some $[a',b']$ with $a'<0<1<b'$.

This only widens a given single-chart hypothesis.
Proof

\sketch The preimage of the chart source is open and contains compact $[0,1]$, hence contains $(-\delta ,1+\delta )$ for some $\delta >0$.

□
